{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: NestedText
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  check-bats-version:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 5
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        python-version: ["3.8", "3.x"]
      max-parallel: 6

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Display Python version
        run: python -c "import sys; print(sys.version)"
      - name: Install packages
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install .
          pip install tox
          pip install coveralls
      - name: Run tests
        run: tox
      - name: Report test coverage
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          COVERALLS_SERVICE_NAME: github
        run: coveralls
",
  "rationale": "Applied two evidence-supported optimizations: (1) Added pip dependency caching using actions/cache@v4 keyed on pyproject.toml, supported by pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE and experiment example experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2 which showed a similar cache step reducing dependency download time. (2) Added a job-level timeout of 5 minutes (timeout-minutes: 5) to bound runaway runs, supported by pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and experiment example experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 which demonstrated elapsed time savings with a custom timeout. Also fixed an incorrect action (setup-node -> setup-python) to ensure the intended Python versions are used, preserving test coverage.",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE",
    "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2",
    "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT",
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"
  ]
}
